headline: Yan 2-1
caption:
Petr Yan beat Merab Dvalishvili again to win their trilogy and keep the UFC bantamweight title.
Yan's next: Song Yadong or O'Malley? 👇

Yan weathered Merab's early pressure and took over late for a unanimous decision, 48-47 on all three cards, at UFC 333 in Abu Dhabi. It won Fight of the Night, and Yan said he'll take anyone, naming Song Yadong.

🔥 Hot take: Yan settled this rivalry. No fourth fight needed.
Disagree? Tell me why you're wrong.
